name: team_planning_budget
description: Get the four budget numbers for a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in: approved, funded, remaining and unfunded. basis is the budget_basis rule: inclusive (base pay plus on-cost, the default) or base_only, and every money figure is on it. Approved is each budget line's amount, made yearly, over the days its period overlaps the scenario's out of 365, in its own currency, beside its head_count; a line with no amount approves null, never zero. Funded is what the seats team_planning_cost prices for this caller cost, each at the share its position draws on a line (as team_planning_funding derives or sets it), for the days of the seat the line's period covers, so it follows pay_view. Unfunded is the rest: the share and days no held draw funds, seats in no position, and forecast rows, which count as their kind prices them on either basis. Funded plus unfunded is team_planning_cost's scenario total, per currency, on an inclusive basis. Remaining is approved less funded in the line's own currency, and head_count less the FTE drawn. Money stays per currency: a line drawn on in another currency lists it in mismatched_currencies, never converted, and only the scenario-wide total and forecast carry `converted` and `missing`, in the reference currency at the period's start; every group sum is `native` alone. cost_centres (by the cost centre a line was approved for, null for none; unfunded money by the seat's cost centre, unfunded head count by the position's) carry all four; budget_lines carry approved, funded and remaining; units carry funded and unfunded. Head counts are positions and FTE: a line or cost centre counts each position drawing on it once, at the FTE it draws, while units and the total count the positions funded whole, as team_planning_funding does, so funded and unfunded add up to every position. A position with a seat no pay band prices still counts in head count and is listed under unpriced with no money; so is one whose on-cost is refused, unless the basis is base_only, which funds its base. Figures are decimal strings. The baseline has no period, so it can't be the scenario. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: A scenario of the plan; not the plan's id, as the baseline has no period.
